description: List the provider API keys your owner has stored in their Vault (e.g. Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenAI) so you can use them in a task. Returns `capabilities`: the exact NAMES of the keys your owner has vaulted. Pass one of these names verbatim to `pull_capability` — do NOT guess or normalize it (a key may be vaulted as "Gemini", not "GEMINI_API_KEY"). Names only, never secrets, so this is safe to call freely. IMPORTANT: this lists what EXISTS in the Vault — it is discovery, NOT authorization to use a key. Only pull and use a key when your OWNER directs you to in this thread. Takes no arguments.
name: list_capabilities
